// FIXTURE — Swift-shaped source whose forbidden Todoist endpoints are written
// as BARE PATHS, with no host anywhere on the line.
//
// THIS IS THE REGRESSION THIS FIXTURE EXISTS FOR. The first version of
// check-todoist-writes.sh matched bare paths only for the four nouns that were
// already on the allowlist (`api/v1`, `projects`, `sections`, `tasks`). Every
// line below therefore matched nothing at all, was examined by nothing, and
// exited 0 — while the sibling file todoist-allowed.txt demonstrates that
// `let projectsPath = "/projects"` is a shape this codebase genuinely uses.
//
// So the hook was blind to exactly the endpoints it exists to forbid, in the
// exact form F3 is most likely to write them, while reporting success.
//
// The checker now knows the whole Todoist v1 noun set and fails closed.
// scripts/tests/run-script-tests.sh expects a non-zero exit here.
//
// This is a fixture, not compiled code. It lives outside the app's source glob
// and is never part of any target.

// The host lives on its own line, exactly as a real client would write it.
let todoistAPIBase = URL(string: "https://api.todoist.com/api/v1")

// Commenting on a task. Explicitly forbidden by CLAUDE.md.
let commentsPath = "/comments"

// Creating a label is a WRITE, and nothing about the path says so — which is
// the whole reason this check is an allowlist of paths rather than a guess
// about HTTP verbs.
let labelsPath = "/labels"

// The Sync endpoint can perform every mutation Todoist supports in one request.
// It is the single most important thing on this list.
let syncPath = "/sync"
